name: OmniRoute
description: OmniRoute is a self-hosted LLM router. The dashboard and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on one port send requests to the provider accounts you connect, with Redis for rate limiting.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Initial password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  omniroute:
    image: diegosouzapw/omniroute:3.8.52@sha256:b08a12e876baa8a5ccadd1ebbe346fe7267dba3b1c9f4fd6bb02070fae41ab6c
    container_name: omniroute
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 40s
    environment:
      DATA_DIR: /app/data
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      REQUIRE_API_KEY: "true"
      INITIAL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_INITIAL_PASSWORD}
      OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB: "2048"
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:20128"
      - "20129:20129"
      - "20132:20132"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "healthcheck.mjs"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
  redis:
    image: redis:8.6.5-alpine@sha256:cd218f4b106a332c5c992e38a9480bfb9d7e9f8f7b0ec9a0023bfa36d9a408f9
    container_name: omniroute-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "60", "1", "--loglevel", "warning"]
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
